notes: Settles chi(|H>^4) = 4 with the Lean rank-4 upper bound, with both directions now free of floating-point margins. Upgraded from reproduced (8.69M numerical pivot-quotient triples with cosine clearance 0.9877) to verified (exact: true) in 0.5 s by a 0-pivot codimension-2 Galois quotient: because |H>^4 lies in Q(i, sqrt(2))^16 while every 4-qubit stabilizer state lies in Q(i)^16, any 3-term decomposition must span the 2D Q(i)-plane P_4 = span_{Q(i)}(A_4, B_4) and therefore project to a single 1D ray in Q(i)^16 / P_4. Exact primitive Z[i]-ray canonicalization across all 36,720 states of D_4 finds 0 states in P_4 and a maximum parallel ray group size of 2 (< 3), so no 3 states can even be collinear in Q(i)^16 / P_4.
